notes.subject: יכחשו
notes.rationale: 'Would feign obedience / cringe / lie to Him' — KJV 'submit', JPS 'dwindle away', YLT 'feign obedience'; rendered as cringing submission.

notes.subject: עתם לעולם
notes.rationale: 'Their time forever' — whose time and which time: their doom (JPS) or their prosperity (KJV) is disputed.

notes.subject: quddiemu
notes.rationale: Hebrew has only 'to Him'; 'quddiemu' (before Him) added to carry the cringing sense.

translation: Dawk li jobgħodu lil Jaħwe jinkampaw quddiemu, u żmienhom ikun għal dejjem.
